description: List upcoming (scheduled) and past (published/failed) posts across all connected accounts. With from + to (ISO-8601 timestamps with UTC offset, at most 62 days) it instead returns every post of any status (awaiting|generating|ready|publishing|published|failed) with slot_at in [from, to) as one slots list plus truncated (true when the cap was hit) — use it to read a day or month. Without from/to it returns two lists: upcoming slots and recent results, each with id, slot_at, status (awaiting|generating|ready|publishing|published|failed; publishing appears in upcoming only when the slot already has userNotices), title, schedule_id, task_id, progress (0-100: 0 for awaiting, 100 for ready/publishing/published, live engine progress for generating, last known for failed), stage (engine pipeline stage like "lipsync" while generating, "done" when complete, null otherwise), queuePosition/queueTotal (1-based position among the schedule's awaiting+generating slots; awaiting slots only, null otherwise). Failed slots also carry error and retryable (boolean: true when the failure looks transient). Use when the user asks about their posts — what is coming next, what already went out, how far a video has generated, where it sits in the queue, or why a post failed. Combine with list_schedules or list_social_accounts when persona/account names are needed. A slot that is still publishing is included in upcoming when it already has userNotices (requiresUser true): relay each notice as-is and do not retry, because only the user can fix the account. providerFailures lists every terminal account failure; its requiresUser is true only for the failures also in userNotices.

from.description: Range mode (with to): start of the window, inclusive. Returns every post of any status with slot_at in [from, to) as a single slots list, plus truncated=true when the cap was hit. At most 62 days.

limit.description: Max number of upcoming and past posts to return (each list). Default 20, max 500. Ignored when from/to are given.

to.description: Range mode (with from): end of the window, exclusive.

name: list_posts
